statement: A candidate only. It lives outside configs/ and matches no loader schema (b2_experiment, b2_loko, b2_execution cannot read it). Every researcher-controlled value is UNAPPROVED; values with status FROZEN_BY_PROTOCOL are carried from P18/P20/K17 and are listed for completeness. Approving any value authorizes no generation, GPU use, training or LOKO.
derivation: Recipe values (width, time_pool, epochs, batch, optimizer, schedule, augmentation, level) are the P6 / TrainConfig defaults; the loss weights (center 0.005, plan BCE 1.0) and the K17b shift (15 %, 0.5 MHz) are the P20 pre-registered values of configs/b2_feat.json, which are NOT TrainConfig code defaults (TrainConfig has center_loss_weight 0.0 and plan_shift_fraction 0.0). All equal the E7a proposal values (b2_e7_training_proposal.json); this file adds no new value except numerics_pin and the mirror of the recommended decisions. No test, test-only, matched or val-calib outcome informed any value.

training_seed_count.note: K17 user decision: three seeds (count only)

training_seed_values.note: report every seed, select none by outcome

model_width.note: P6/TrainConfig default; the width-8 budget does not carry over (P32 section 4)

epochs.note: 30 is a P6 assumption never validated on B2; no sizing run, no early stopping

value.name: AdamW
value.decay_applies_to: all parameters: convolutions, BatchNorm affine, linear heads, auxiliary head and the CenterLoss centres
value.effective_beta1_with_OneCycleLR: cycled 0.95 -> 0.85 -> 0.95 (cycle_momentum=True overwrites the constructor value 0.9 when the scheduler is constructed; measured over an 11,250-step schedule)

value.mirror: frequency-axis flip with probability 0.5 per sample
value.roll: circular time shift, ONE random shift per mini-batch (not per sample)

value.cudnn_allow_tf32: torch 2.14.1 default True: convolutions run in TF32 on Ampere or newer GPUs unless the lock pins the flag

precision_and_determinism.note: the TF32 flags are not pinned anywhere in src/; see numerics_pin

loss_composition.value: cross-entropy (unweighted, mean) + center_loss_weight x centre loss + plan_loss_weight x plan BCE (auxiliary head, independent of the label)

center_loss_weight.note: K18 option A: P20 sum-of-squares weight; times D = 256 gives 1.28 on the per-dimension mean square at width 16

value.selection: Bernoulli per sample per batch (expected fraction, not exact)
value.scope: training only; val-select, val-calib and test masks are never shifted

streaming_groups_per_shard.note: part of the generator request; fixed at DR-04 time; the generators default to 8

checkpoint_selection_rule.value: best val-select macro-F1 over the 8 known classes (clean + 7), evaluated after every epoch; strict '>' so the first epoch reaching the maximum is kept; the auxiliary plan head is monitored, not selected on

value.statistics: train-role embeddings of the selected checkpoint (eval mode), class-conditional

mahalanobis_fit.note: regularization 0.1 is a P20/pilot constant, not a P18 number

calibration.note: acceptance 0.95 is a P20/pilot constant; clean alarm Pfa 0.05 is also P18

cudnn_allow_tf32.note: torch 2.14.1 defaults cuDNN TF32 to True, so on Ampere or newer GPUs convolutions would run in TF32 although the recipe says fp32; pinning False needs the production executor milestone (a src/geoml edit before the lock) and costs convolution speed

deterministic_algorithms.note: no deterministic flags exist today; a fixed-seed GPU restart is not a bit-identical replay (R9)

numerics_pin.torch_version: pinned in the production lock (the lock records the version; a torch change fails lock-verify)

K18.summary: keep P20: 0.005 x sum of squared distances, plan BCE 1.0; keep the observation-only train diagnostic

K17d.summary: keep B2-test/1 frozen; report all 500 groups plus a predeclared 35-group co-feed missing-carrier sub-row and a sensitivity row excluding them

OBS-CANCEL-2.summary: keep obs-cancel/1 as the primary receiver; state the 21.7-25 dB phase-noise depth ceiling next to residual results

R1.recommended: co, dual, dual_residual x seeds 0,1,2 (nine fits)

R4.recommended: 30 epochs unchanged, fixed-length OneCycle, no early stopping, no sizing run

R6.recommended: P6 recipe as implemented; TF32 pinned off

R7.recommended: 4 groups per shard x 4 shards per window (blocked shuffle, at most 16 scenario groups per window)

R8.recommended: P31 train-only -> known val-calib -> freeze -> evaluate; all nine cells verified before the first test read

R9.recommended: restart the interrupted view/seed from epoch 0, record the parent checkpoint hash, never splice

R10.recommended: confirm acceptance 0.95, clean Pfa 0.05, Mahalanobis regularization 0.1

not_in_this_file: host, GPU model, VRAM ceiling, wall/GPU-hour/disk ceilings (DR-04, DR-05)
activation: None in this change. A frozen configuration needs: the researcher's recorded decisions, a P18 section 10 entry only where a value departs from the defaults, a separate reviewed commit that adds the config under configs/, and the production lock created after the last src/ edit.
